_comment: Written by the colour-script agent at Stage 06b, after beat_map.json. Phases are given by BEAT id (from_beat/to_beat), never by timecode: code maps beats to time. Offsets are relative to the house grade, in the units of presets/color/color_rules.json. Omitted fields = 0. Checked by: python tools/color_script.py plan ...
story_logic: The boy's home in Ohio is the only warm place in the story: warmth = being held by family. The city that takes the ticket is drained and faintly green-gray, the colour of the courtroom photographs. Warmth comes back only once, when the letter arrives, and it is weaker than before: he is not a child any more.

motifs.name: the gold ticket
motifs.meaning: the promise; brightest when it is new, gone when it is taken

phases.name: Ohio, before
phases.intent: safety, home, a promise in a pocket
phases.reason: Establishes the warm reference the rest of the story loses (story_logic).

phases.name: The city
phases.reason: B025 is the arrival: the warmth drains over one blend so the viewer feels the distance from home.

phases.name: The court
phases.reason: Matches the courtroom photographs themselves (green-gray, hard light); tension beats B070-B090 at intensity 4-5.

phases.name: The ticket is taken
phases.reason: B098 is the ruling: the story cuts hard, so the colour does too. The court's hard contrast collapses into a washed, lifted flatness: nothing left to push against.

transition_in.reason: the ruling (B098) is a sudden loss

phases.name: The letter
phases.reason: Callback to Ohio when the letter arrives, deliberately weaker (story_logic: he is not a child any more).
phases.callback_variation: weaker on purpose: he is not a child any more
